desc: 几何切面小花瓶配多肉草穗，暖调高低错落陈设治愈家
leaf: 侘寂几何切面陶瓷小花瓶多肉草穗组合摆件
name: 侘寂暖调陶瓷小花瓶多肉草穗款

shots.intent: 白底把整组瓶器的高低错落轮廓与株型一次交代清楚，先赢搜索位点击。
详情页首屏用主色场与暖光把最高的那支立住，一秒传达治愈系家调主张。
shots.textZone: upper-left Chinese headline 「{selling_point_1}」 with a small English kicker 「{callout_1}」 and one 1.5pt hairline rule beneath it; one narrow vertical kicker strip along the right edge

shots.intent: 同一台面同一机位的空与满并置，把桌面单调这个具体痛点演给买家看。
shots.textZone: short heading 「{selling_point_1}」 above the split, one #2F3E4C caption bar under each panel reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 把组合放进真实客厅台面并给出尺度锚点，让买家代入自家茶几与边几。
侧面立住瓶器与株型轮廓，并把换水养护情境摆进卧室，回答打理难度疑虑。
同机位同光对照单支摆法与高矮组合摆法，用可见的层次差证明组合的价值。
shots.textZone: one short caption under each panel reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」, no other copy

shots.intent: 微距贴近棱线与釉面转折，用做工本身证明瓶器质感，不依赖任何文字主张。
正俯视同时交代瓶口厚度、开口与植株展开形态，把鲜活度与株型一次证明。
shots.textZone: three short labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 carried by 1.5pt hairline leader lines with numbered circles

shots.intent: 把整组的相对高低与各自尺寸用引线标出，消除放不放得下的疑虑。
shots.textZone: short heading 「{selling_point_1}」 at the top and one dimension callout per piece reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」 in #2F3E4C at the end of each hairline bracket

shots.intent: 同款多色多款同光同角度并排，配色卡让买家一次比色完成选款。
shots.textZone: one short caption under each piece reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」 plus a short heading 「{selling_point_1}」 at the top

shots.intent: 仰角把瓶器分量感拉满并回到次色场收口，用可见工艺细节而非资质消除风险。
shots.textZone: Chinese closing line 「{selling_point_1}」 in the upper third and three short craft labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 on 1.5pt hairline rules beneath the group

style.backgroundSystem: flat primary field #C75B39 alternating with secondary deep field #2F3E4C and a matte plaster wall #F2EDE4, all grounded on a veined marble ledge #F5F3F0; warm oak #B4784A geometric blocks and one #F2EDE4 plinth are the only recurring set pieces; no scenery drift beyond a single soft leaf shadow
style.direction: warm cream wabi-sabi home-decor vessel commerce
style.iconSystem: none; only 1.5pt hairline underline rules, thin dimension leader lines with bracket ends, numbered circles and square-tile info cards as infographic components
style.lightingSystem: soft front-left key at 4500-5200K with one large fill card, low contrast, a soft contact shadow that always grounds every vessel, glaze and matte facet surfaces kept readable with no blown highlights, one consistent shadow direction across the whole set
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm cream wabi-sabi home-decor vessel commerce across the entire image set; fixed palette of primary field #C75B39, secondary deep field #2F3E4C, base surface #F2EDE4 and one accent #8FA98B pinned to the reference product's own plant tone; warm grade throughout with a true #FFFFFF reserved only for the packshot; modern geometric sans-serif, Chinese headline 30-42pt wrapped in 「」, English kicker 14-18pt, caption 11-14pt on a #2F3E4C bar; background system of flat #C75B39 fields alternating with #2F3E4C fields and a matte plaster wall #F2EDE4, all grounded on a veined marble ledge #F5F3F0, with warm oak #B4784A geometric blocks and one #F2EDE4 plinth as the only recurring set pieces; lighting system of a soft front-left key at 4500-5200K with one large fill card, low contrast, a soft contact shadow that always grounds every vessel, glaze and matte facet surfaces readable with no blown highlights, one consistent shadow direction; 1.5pt hairline rules, thin dimension leader lines with bracket ends, numbered circles and square-tile info cards as the only graphic components, no icon set; presentation rules: the vessel forms, faceted geometry, rim thickness, finish, proportions, base feet and the way plant material rises out of each mouth stay exactly as in the reference, no vessel floats, the same slight 3/4 hero angle carries across packshot and variant screens, stable height staggering and product scale between shots; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no invented plant parts or colorways, no mismatched card styles, no QR codes or store badges.
noDrift: no invented plant parts, flowers, fruit or colorways
no mismatched card or label styles
no QR codes, store badges or membership marks
